value.rationale: The exact optimizer switches nonmonotonically under one scalar controller-gain adjustment on a natural weighted tree, even with only six vertices; the result proves this effect in every balanced size, locates the entire open reentrant region and all ties, and gives its inverse-cubic parameter width. This clarifies feedback-placement design beyond algorithmic minimization and provides a sharp symbolic benchmark for consensus control.
